summary: Slowreel round 2, phase A: classic synths + arpeggiator, and the drum machine + 808 + step sequencer (new files only)

result.synths:
SYNTHS lane is finished: the 7 synths and the arpeggiator render cleanly, and the test suite passes (`round2-synths.cjs`, about 43 s).

**Files** (all new; I edited no existing files):
- `/home/user/nicofoxheart/studio/teams/tape/js/sound/synths.js`: these were already there from before the usage limit. This session I only changed three output levels after measuring: Analog Poly +3.7 dB, Vox Pad −2 dB, Supersaw −1.6 dB.
- `/home/user/nicofoxheart/studio/teams/tape/js/sound/arp.js`: already there from before the usage limit; I didn't change it.
- `/home/user/nicofoxheart/studio/teams/tape/tests/round2-synths.html` and `round2-synths.cjs` (new). Run with `cd /home/user/nicofoxheart/studio && NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) node teams/tape/tests/round2-synths.cjs [presets|arp]`.
- Test outputs in `/home/user/nicofoxheart/studio/teams/tape/qa/`: `round2-synth-{supersaw,analog,fmkeys,lead,synthbass,synthpluck,voxpad,arp}.wav` and `.png` (spectrograms), plus `round2-synths-results.json`.
- Appended 3 lines to `/home/user/nicofoxheart/studio/BUILD-LOG.md`.

**Exported API**

From `js/sound/synths.js`:
- `SYNTHS`: an array of 7 instrument definitions in the same format as `instruments.js`: `{id, name, kind:'synth', maxVoices, params:[{id,name,min,max,default,unit,type?,options?:[{value,label}]}], macros:[paramIds], presets:[{id,name,params}], voice(ctx, env, params, midi, vel, t)}`.
  - The ids are `supersaw`, `analog`, `fmkeys`, `lead` (mono), `synthbass` (mono), `synthpluck` and `voxpad`.
  - There are 30 presets in total, 4–5 per synth; each synth has 4 macros and a `level` param.
- `SYNTH_MAP`: `{id: def}`.
- To register them: `for (const s of SYNTHS) { INSTRUMENTS.push(s); INSTRUMENT_MAP[s.id] = s; }`. The engine then lists them, and `resolveParams` and `setParam` work on them without other changes.

From `js/sound/arp.js`:
- `ARP_PARAMS` (same param format, so the Sound tab can draw them):
  - `on` (toggle)
  - `rate` (enum: `'1/4'`, `'1/8'`, `'1/8T'`, `'1/16'`, `'1/16T'`, `'1/32'`)
  - `pattern` (enum: `up`, `down`, `updown`, `random`, `played`)
  - `octaves` (1–4)
  - `gate` (0.05–1)
  - `swing` (0–0.75)
- Also exported: `ARP_DEFAULTS`, `ARP_RATES`, `arpSettings(s)` and `arpStepBeats(s)`.
- Settings live in `track.arp = {on, rate, pattern, octaves, gate, swing}`.
- `arpProcess(notes, settings, bpm, lengthBeats?)` takes and returns `[{p, s, d, v}]` (beats, relative to the clip). If the arp is off it returns the input unchanged.
- `arpNotes(clip, settings, bpm)` is a cached version for the scheduler. Use it in place of `clip.notes`; it is safe to call on every tick.
- `createLiveArp(engine, trackId, () => track.arp, () => project.bpm)` returns `{active(), noteOn(midi, vel), noteOff(midi), allOff(), held(), dispose()}`.
  - `engine` needs `noteOn`, `noteOff`, `position` and `context`; the real engine has all of them.
  - Send live keys through it only while `active()` is true. It locks to the song's beat grid while the transport is playing.

**Test numbers** (in the test's real-engine render; the integrator still has to register the synths in the app itself)
- **Format:** all 7 definitions pass the format checks (enum options, defaults in range, preset keys exist, macros exist), and the engine lists all 7.
- **Presets:** all 30 render with peaks between −5.1 and −20.3 dBFS, with 0 clipped samples, 0 NaN and no DC offset. The release tails decay to at most −93 dB. The test phrases peak at 9 voices and 289 audio nodes.
- **Spectrograms:** checked, and the bass's spectral peak is at 110 Hz.
- **Stress test:** 128 notes in 2 s on Supersaw peaks at −19.4 dBFS, 1,675 nodes. The engine's voice counter peaks at 72 there, but Felt Piano reaches 78 on the same notes, so that's how the engine counts fading voices, not a synth problem.
- **Arpeggiator:** all 21 pattern/timing checks pass (rates, triplets, patterns, 4 octaves, swing, gate, clip end, gaps, repeatable random, caching). An arp render on Pluck Synth peaks at −16.9 dBFS. The live arp on a real AudioContext keeps 125 ms steps with at most 6 ms jitter; every note-on gets a note-off, and the track meter reads −20 dB.

**Known limits**
- The arp has to be wired in by the integrator: the scheduler must call `arpNotes`, the live keys must go through `createLiveArp`, and the controls must go in the Sound tab.
- In `arpProcess`, steps count from beat 0 of the clip, not the song.
- The "random" pattern repeats the same order on every render.
- Mono glide in Lead and Synth Bass works per track. Two clips overlapping on the same mono track cut each other off.
- Every spectrogram shows a dark band at about 0.9–1 kHz. It's probably the shared reverb/echo path, since it appears on every synth, but I didn't investigate it.
result.beats:
BEATS lane is finished and the full test suite passes (`node teams/tape/tests/round2-beats.cjs`, 20 s). I picked up the `drums.js` that was already there, fixed a bug in the 808 legato handling, rebalanced the kit levels, then wrote the step editor and the tests. I only wrote my own files.

**Files**
- `/home/user/nicofoxheart/studio/teams/tape/js/sound/drums.js`
- `/home/user/nicofoxheart/studio/teams/tape/js/ui/steps.js`
- `/home/user/nicofoxheart/studio/teams/tape/tests/round2-beats.cjs` (run with `NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) node teams/tape/tests/round2-beats.cjs [logic|sound|ui]` from the studio root) and `/home/user/nicofoxheart/studio/teams/tape/tests/round2-beats.html`
- Outputs in `/home/user/nicofoxheart/studio/teams/tape/qa/`: `beats-results.json`, `beats-drums-spectrogram.png`, `beats-808-spectrogram.png`, `beats-steps.png`, `beats-raw-drums.wav`, `beats-groove-phonk.wav`, `beats-808-glide.wav`, `beats-808-phonk.wav`
- 3 lines appended to `BUILD-LOG.md`

**Exported API**

From `js/sound/drums.js`:
- **`DRUM_INSTRUMENTS`** = `[DRUMS, BASS808]`. Both use the same instrument format as `instruments.js` (`{id, name, kind, maxVoices, params, macros:[ids], presets:[{id,name,params}], voice(ctx, env, P, midi, vel, t)}`).
  - **To register them:** `for (const d of DRUM_INSTRUMENTS) { INSTRUMENTS.push(d); INSTRUMENT_MAP[d.id] = d; }`, done before `createEngine`, because the engine copies its instrument list when it is created.
- **`drums`** (Drum Machine, kind `'drums'`, up to 24 voices):
  - Kits (presets): `future-garage`, `phonk`, `lofi-dust`, `soft-ambient`.
  - Macros: `punch`, `tone`, `grit`, `decay`.
  - Extra params, per voice model: `<model>Tune` (-12..12 st), `<model>Decay`, `<model>Level`, for the models kick, snare, clap, rim, hat, ohat, shaker, tom, cowbell, crash and riser.
  - The voice uses `env.bpm()` so the noise riser follows the tempo.
- **`bass808`** (808 Bass, kind `'bass'`):
  - Presets: `deep-sub`, `phonk-808`, `garage-sub`, `slide-808`.
  - Macros: `glide`, `drive`, `length`, `punch`; extra params: `tone`, `bend`, `level`.
  - It is mono: overlapping notes glide.
- **`DRUM_MAP`**: `[{midi, voice, name, short, tune?, lvl?, dec?}]` for MIDI 36-51:
  - 36 Kick, 37 Rim, 38 Snare, 39 Clap, 40 Snare ghost, 41 Tom low
  - 42 Closed hat, 43 Tom mid, 44 Shaker, 45 Tom high, 46 Open hat
  - 47 Cowbell, 48 Cowbell high, 49 Crash, 50 Noise riser, 51 Boom kick
- Also exported: `DRUM_BY_MIDI`, `DRUMS`, `BASS808`.

From `js/ui/steps.js`:
- **`initSteps(paneEl, {isActive?})`**: call once. `isActive` defaults to `() => S.tab === 'beats'`. It injects its own `<style id="stp-css">` using the existing tokens, and listens to `render` / `select` by itself.
- **`renderSteps()`**: call when the Beats tab opens. It returns `true` when a drum clip is shown. Otherwise it shows a short message with buttons to open one of the drum track's clips or make a "New 1-bar pattern".
- **`isDrumTrack(t)`**: true when `t.instrument.id === 'drums'`.
- **Data model:** the editor reads and writes the clip's ordinary `notes` (`{p, s, d, v}`; each step is 0.25 beat). It also keeps optional data in `clip.beat = {steps, swing, mute:[midi], muted:[notes]}`, which the engine ignores. Notes on a muted row move into `clip.beat.muted`, so `notes` is always exactly what plays. Swing delays every odd step by `swing × 0.25` beats.
- **Helpers** (no DOM, safe in Node), for building the Night Garage demo in code: `setStep(clip, midi, step, vel)`, `getStep`, `toggleStep`, `setSwing(clip, 0..0.75)`, `setLength(clip, steps 4..128)`, `repeatPattern(clip, times)`, `setRowMute(clip, midi, bool)`, `clearPattern`, `readGrid(clip)`, `beatInfo`, `stepPos`, `stepOf`, `nextVel`, `STEP_BEATS`, `DRUM_ROWS`.

**Test numbers**
- **Logic:** 20 checks pass in Node.
- **Single hits, each kit, velocity 1** (all 16 voices sound in every kit, quietest is the noise riser at -24 to -34):

  | Kit | Loudest peak |
  |---|---|
  | Future Garage | -6.5 dBFS |
  | Phonk | -6.7 dBFS |
  | Lo-fi Dust | -7.2 dBFS |
  | Soft Ambient | -9.0 dBFS |

  Every voice is cleaned up when it ends.
- **2-bar shuffled grooves through the engine** (track at -6 dB):

  | Kit | Peak | RMS | Voice count (engine stat) | Nodes |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | Future Garage | -10.9 | -31.0 | 18 | 267 |
  | Phonk | -7.1 | -25.9 | 28 | 397 |
  | Lo-fi Dust | -9.5 | -28.4 | 18 | 272 |
  | Soft Ambient | -14.0 | -32.5 | 21 | 243 |

  All have 0 clipped samples, no NaN, and fade below -60 dB with no voices left at the end.
- **808 presets:** peaks -7.6 to -10.8 dBFS. The Phonk 808 at 0 dB track volume peaks at -4.7.
- **808 glide:** 65.4 Hz, then 98.1 Hz after the overlapping note, then 87.3 Hz. The expected values were 65.4, 98.0 and 87.3. At most 2 voices counted.
- **UI test in the real app:** toggle, drag-paint, drag velocity (ends at 0.4), alt-click ghost, row mute and unmute, swing knob, length 32, Repeat ×2, keyboard toggle, undo, and playback (track meter -14 to -16 dB, playhead shows). 0 console errors and no horizontal overflow.
- **Spectrograms checked:** clean kick/tom sweeps, metallic cowbell and hat partials, the riser sweep, and a pure 808 sub with the glide steps visible.

**Known limits**
- **Stress case:** 128 hits at full velocity in one bar, track at 0 dB. It peaks at -1.3 dBFS, so the safety limiter does engage there; there is no clipping. The engine's voice count reads 87 because it includes notes scheduled up to 1 s ahead. The drum track itself plays at most 24 voices at once.
- **808 is last-note only:** releasing a newer note while an older one is still held does not glide back to the older note.
- **Swing snaps off-grid notes:** changing swing (or reading the grid) moves drum notes that were placed off the 16th grid in the piano roll to the nearest step. Notes outside MIDI 36-51 are never touched.
- **Pattern length sets clip length:** shrinking a pattern keeps the notes past the new end, but they don't play.
- **No per-voice knobs in the step editor:** per-voice tune, decay and level show only in the Sound tab's extra params, and there are 33 of them.
- **Wiring left for the integrator:** the Beats tab button, a `pane-beats` element, and registering the instruments.
